summary: Performs time-offset ridge regression to evaluate if neural activity encodes past behavioral velocity, quantifying performance against shuffled control decoders.
use_when: Does current neural activity contain information about past behavior?
How to implement time-lagged ridge regression for neural decoding?
Calculate decoding performance difference between actual and scrambled behavior
Predict velocity from neural activity at various time offsets
Generate performance plots for neural behavioral predictive modeling
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
